propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger, which is process-global and never restored, breaking caplog record capture for all rebar.* loggers in subsequent tests
pytest caplog relies on record propagation to the root logger, so once the rebar logger has propagate=False, no rebar.* records reach caplog and assertions silently fail
test failures are non-deterministic and order-dependent because they occur only when configure_logging() executes in a worker process before a caplog assertion in the same process
setting propagate=False prevents silent void windows in a single test phase where caplog captures nothing after configure_logging() is called mid-assertion
the propagate=False was intended to prevent double-logging through uvicorn/root in production, but uvicorn does not add root handlers so propagation would not cause duplicates
